agentglass Android companion app (React Native, signed APK)

claims.answer: Electron desktop app for Linux (AppImage, deb), macOS (unsigned dmg, Apple silicon and Intel) and Windows (exe, built in CI but not verified on hardware), plus a signed Android companion APK; agentglass-ui, agentglass-agent and agentglass-cleanup CLIs; no iOS app, phone browser client or editor extension.

desktop_os.answer: Release v1.0.0 ships AppImage and deb, arm64 and x64 dmg and an exe; the README table marks Linux working, macOS working but unsigned and Windows not verified on real metal.

mobile_apps.answer: A native Android companion paired by a scanned code; no iOS app is offered.

mobile_browser.answer: The phone web app was replaced by the Android app because WebCrypto needs a secure context for pairing over plain HTTP.

cli.answer: agentglass-ui, agentglass-agent (start, prompt, wait, read, send-keys, list, stop, schedule) and agentglass-cleanup.

editor_extensions.answer: No editor extension; plugins are separate processes.

task_actions.answer: Start agents in worktrees from tasks or issues, steer in terminals, allow or deny gated tool calls, review pull requests and diffs from the desktop; the phone answers approvals and reads terminals, PRs and changes at the granted scope.

notifications.answer: Bell and cards in the app, desktop notifications, phone alerts at a scope, and an opt-in Slack or Discord webhook.

cross_device_continuity.answer: The phone reads the same server over your own network or tailnet, so approvals and terminals are shared with the desk.

limitations: macOS builds are unsigned (an xattr step is required), Windows is not verified on real hardware, and the Android app is distributed only as an APK outside any store.
